diagnosis: The subscription connects subscribers to the real-time presence and cursor tracking channel of doc_uuid without confirming that info.context.user has read or collaborator permissions on the target document. An authenticated tenant user can monitor editor identities, typing activity, and active paragraph selections on private unshared draft documents.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/ws/ HTTP/1.1
Host: docs.enterprise-collab.com
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
